tie_rule: if max(pch, pdch) <= 1e-9 p.u. the period carries no meaningful dispatch; the mode is then set to charge-dominant deterministically
rejection_logic: fixed-mode set is a SUBSET of the MISOCP set, so Q_MISOCP <= Q_fixed_mode <= V for any primal-feasible V; a low V therefore bounds the MISOCP optimum from above
